newsitem.title: JAPAN: Biwako Bank shares suspended on Osaka bourse.
newsitem.headline: Biwako Bank shares suspended on Osaka bourse.

text.p: Shares in Biwako Bank Ltd were suspended for the rest of Wednesday on the Osaka Securities Exchange (OSE), the exchange said.
The OSE said it had decided on the suspension because of a lack of sufficient information on the bank's management.

The bank said earlier that it would hold news briefings at 12.15 p.m. (0315 GMT) and 1.30 p.m. (0430 GMT) on what it called the improper actions of a former employee. It did not elaborate on the nature of the actions, but said there was no financial problem as a result of the incident.
The briefings will be held at the bank's headquarters in Ohtsu City, western Japan.
Bank president Yoshio Imai will attend the news conference to be held at 0430 GMT, a bank official said.
Biwako is a regional bank based in western Japan.
